text:
nina: uploaded a prototype card for "route cost insights". shows per-route tokens, per-model SKU cost, and a "fallback cost" column that estimates cost when routing falls back to cheaper model variants. preview: https://staging.redwood.internal/dash/route-insights

omar: interesting. how do you compute fallback cost? is it simulated or based on observed fallbacks?

nina: currently simulated. we take observed route traffic, apply routing policy rules (percent traffic to primary vs fallback), and multiply by model SKU unit cost. config used is in a small json attached to the staging endpoint.

lucy: finance will want to see raw vs simulated separated. add a `simulated_fallback` boolean and a `provenance` field per row. otherwise people assume it's billing-grade.

nina: good call. will add `provenance: simulated|observed` and `sample_rate`.

fin-sre: deploy-bot: please include exportable rows with provenance for audits.

deploy-bot: deploy 6677770001-route-insights -> staging succeeded (12s)

omar: also, cache savings: are we attributing shared prefetch across tenants? that's been a sore spot.

nina: prefetch credit currently naive: direct hits only. we can enable an amortizer that splits shared prefetch by route_id within a time window, but it's heavier. thinking of making it a nightly rollup and showing it as an optional column.

lucy: UX: show raw_cache_hits, amortized_prefetch_credit, and a confidence tag. default hide amortized. add tooltip that says "amortized uses 5m microbatch; may be negative during eviction races."

omar: technical: the amortizer's join needs to be capped. suggest capping to top-50 owners per prefetch key and roll rest into an "other" bucket. otherwise the microbatch can OOM on hot keys.

nina: will cap at 50 and document the cap in the dashboard help.

fin-sre: one more: per-model economics. Customers see logical model names but billing is per SKU. dashboard should expose both and allow pivot. Also include `variant` (quantized, fp16) so cost deltas are explainable.

nina: done. added columns: `model_name`, `sku`, `variant`, `unit_cost_per_token`.

lucy: rollout plan? we should gate simulated fallback and amortized columns behind flags: `insights_simulated_fallback` and `insights_amortized_prefetch`. start internal 1w, then finance beta.

nina: agreed. flags added; default off in prod. export includes `schema_version=1`.

omar: small API ask: include `explainability` json blob per route row that lists the inputs to the cost calc (traffic, routing weights, sample_rate). that's helpful for debugging.

nina: will add an `explain_inputs` string (flattened key=val pairs) to keep response schema flat.

lucy: QA: schedule a 30m with finance + observability to validate negative amortized values and simulated fallback assumptions.

fin-sre: i'll join. also ask product to review wording on the confidence labels.

nina: booking 30m for tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:
